Question Choices: How many pairs of parallel lines are formed by the edges of a rectangular window?
Hints: Count pairs within each parallel direction; count each horizontal-vertical pair for right-angle intersections.
Solution: A rectangle has two pairs of opposite parallel sides: top/bottom and left/right.

Question Choices: Select. Draw an upright capital L using one vertical post and one horizontal base that meet at an endpoint. What is the relationship between these two segments? ~~Parallel | Perpendicular~~
Hints: Compare the angle where the horizontal and vertical segments meet with a right angle.
Solution: The vertical post and horizontal base meet at 90 degrees. Therefore they are perpendicular. They are not parallel because they meet.

Question Choices: Select. Use upright capital letters made from straight segments, with no serifs. T, E and L each have horizontal segments meeting a vertical post. A is made from the two sloping sides of an equilateral triangle and a horizontal crossbar. Which letter has no perpendicular segments? ~~T | E | L | A~~
Hints: Look for a right angle in each specified letter.
Solution: The horizontal and vertical segments in T, E and L meet at 90 degrees. The sloping sides of A meet at 60 degrees; the crossbar meets them at 60-degree and 120-degree angles. None is a right angle, so A has no perpendicular segments.

Question Choices: Select. Two distinct straight streets both run North-South. How are the streets related?: ~~Parallel | Perpendicular~~
Hints: Parallel lines lie in a plane and keep the same distance apart; they never meet.
Solution: Two distinct straight north-south streets run in the same direction and do not intersect; they are parallel.

Question Choices: Select. Line segment XY is parallel to segment WZ. If you draw a line connecting X to W that is perpendicular to WZ, will it also be perpendicular to XY? ~~Yes | No~~
Hints: A line perpendicular to one of two parallel lines is perpendicular to the other.
Solution: XY and WZ are parallel. A line perpendicular to WZ makes a 90-degree corresponding angle with XY too, so it is perpendicular to both.
